name: Ace of Swords
title: Ace of Swords
imagery: A great sword rises upward, piercing a crown of light, its blade inscribed. Rays of light radiate around it.
meaning: The Ace of Swords is the root of Air: pure intellect, clarity and truth. A breakthrough in understanding is near.
numerology: The Ace is the seed of the element.

ctx.past: A moment of insight changed you.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a hard truth.

name: Two of Swords
title: Two of Swords: Peace
imagery: Two crossed swords are united by a blue rose at their center, surrounded by calm geometric patterns.
meaning: Peace is mental harmony after tension. A truce has been reached. Rest in this balance.

name: Three of Swords
title: Three of Swords: Sorrow
imagery: Three swords pierce a rose whose petals are falling, against a dark, stormy background.
meaning: Sorrow is mental and emotional pain. Grief must be felt to heal.
affirmation: I allow myself to grieve and heal.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be unprocessed grief.
ctx.gift: Your gift is healing through grief.

name: Four of Swords
title: Four of Swords: Truce
imagery: Four swords meet at their points in the center of a rose, arranged in perfect order.
meaning: Truce is a pause from conflict. Rest and recovery are needed. Accept a compromise for now.

name: Five of Swords
title: Five of Swords: Defeat
imagery: Five broken swords form an inverted pentagram, their hilts and blades shattered.
meaning: Defeat is mental loss. Accept the setback, learn and regroup.

name: Six of Swords
title: Six of Swords: Science
imagery: Six swords point toward a rose cross at the center, forming a precise, balanced geometric pattern.
meaning: Science is objective understanding. Logic and insight help you see clearly.

name: Seven of Swords
title: Seven of Swords: Futility
imagery: Six small swords press against one large sword, their efforts appearing futile.
meaning: Futility is mental effort wasted. Plans may fail through weakness or compromise. Strengthen your resolve.

ctx.gift: Your gift is the chance to refocus.

name: Eight of Swords
title: Eight of Swords: Interference
imagery: Two long swords cross over six shorter ones, blocking their paths.
meaning: Interference is mental blockage. Distractions or obstacles get in the way. Clear your mind and focus.
affirmation: I clear the obstacles in my mind.

name: Nine of Swords
title: Nine of Swords: Cruelty
imagery: Nine jagged, rusty swords point downward, dripping against a dark background.
meaning: Cruelty is mental anguish. Thoughts may turn against you. Seek support and compassion.

ctx.gift: Your gift is the strength to heal.

name: Ten of Swords
title: Ten of Swords: Ruin
imagery: Ten swords shatter a central heart-shaped form, their points crowding together in disarray.
meaning: Ruin is the collapse of a structure of thought. It is painful, but clears the way for something new.

name: Page of Swords
title: Princess of Swords
imagery: A princess stands with sword raised beside an empty altar, among stormy clouds, ready to defend.
meaning: The Princess of Swords is sharp and vigilant. She fights for what is right with practical clarity.
numerology: The Princess is the element made manifest.

name: Knight of Swords
title: Prince of Swords
imagery: A prince rides a chariot pulled by small winged children, swinging a sword and a sickle among geometric forms.
meaning: The Prince of Swords is pure intellect: full of ideas, restless and analytical.
numerology: The Prince is the element in motion.

name: Queen of Swords
title: Queen of Swords
imagery: A queen sits enthroned on clouds, holding a sword in one hand and a severed mask in the other, a child's head crowning her.
meaning: The Queen of Swords cuts through illusion. She is perceptive, honest and liberating.
numerology: The Queen is the receptive power.

name: King of Swords
title: Knight of Swords
imagery: An armored knight charges on horseback through the air, sword drawn, with birds flying around him.
meaning: The Thoth Knight of Swords is purposeful action of the mind. He is focused and determined, sometimes aggressive.
numerology: The Knight is the element at its most active.
